comment: M08 golden-slice faction read. A joined player steps through the checkpoint opening to wake the records hall, then posed views frame its Clerks and Sweepers against the cabinets, desks and lamps at fighting distance. Later groups are chained behind earlier clears, so the Auditor, the custody Sweepers it repairs and the Proximity Mine lesson are read through the combat route in client/qa/m08_custodian_of_record.json. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m08_custodian_of_record.json. Check black armour, red visors, armbands and optics against the archive's green enamel and warm pools; art review, not combat evidence.
